own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm

fda.text: RISK OF HEPATOTOXICITY JUXTAPID can cause elevations in transaminases. summary: Lomitapide carries the strongest warning from the FDA due to the risk of liver harm, as it can raise liver enzymes, and it may also harm an unborn baby [3][4]. In addition, stomach and gut reactions occurred in 93% of adults and 72% of children treated with the drug [4]. According to a small computer model rather than human tests, the drug received a low score of 37 for liver risk and a high score of 69 for heart risk [M].
